{{Top|leg}}
A '''laser wrench''' was a type of [[Wrench/Legends|wrench]] that could be used to remove [[Starship/Legends|starship]] components.<ref name="TNR">''[[The New Rebellion]]''</ref> In [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the businessman [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] utilized an all-purpose laser wrench for removing a panel under the [[Computer/Legends|console]] of his vessel [[Lady Luck/Legends|''Lady Luck'']] while deliberately disabling the ship as part of a ploy to infiltrate the [[Smuggler's Run]]. Around the same [[Time/Legends|time]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] [[Cole Fardreamer]] used a laser wrench while working on the [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] of the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in a New Republic [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bay on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TNR" />
